exposure: continuation of OnabotulinumtoxinA treatment for chronic migraine during pregnancy
discontinuation of OnabotulinumtoxinA treatment for chronic migraine during pregnancy
cohort: The study included 126 subjects who became pregnant during treatment with OnabotulinumtoxinA for chronic migraine.
finding: Subjects who continued OnabotulinumtoxinA in pregnancy continued to have migraine remission with no evidence of adverse pregnancy outcomes, compared to those who discontinued treatment.
